title: A Codex test still running in a worktree after its turn closed does not overlap another writable session's checks there
outcome: A Codex test of one session that is still running in a worktree after its turn closed (EngramSessionState::running_codex_tests) overlaps a check another writable session starts in that worktree, in the same way another session's in-turn running command does (engram_other_writer_cause), until its end is reported or its runtime exits or is replaced.
acceptance: A test shows session S1's still-running carried Codex test in worktree W overlapping a check session S2 starts in W, with the cause naming another session's still-running test, and not overlapping it once S1's test end is reported.
The full gate passes on the exact committed tree.

completion.summary: Cross-session carried Codex tests now overlap writable checks in the same worktree until their end is reported.
